applies_to: Five exceptional A entries; read alongside the original 24-entry research packet. This supersedes only classification wording and the noted Abandon prose error. Original packet remains preserved as reviewed history.
application_status: Research only; app, 2021 and Absorb unchanged. No runtime schema/category implemented.
precedence: User accepted Colorless / Outside the Five Colors treatment for Annihilator. Other classifications are analyst proposals grounded in the cited facts.
access_limitations: Fandom Activate page and both Wizards articles were readable. Fandom Abandon, Attach and Unknown Event list returned 402 in this browser lookup; supplied excerpts were treated as leads and checked against accessible original sources or saved Scryfall card facts.

wizards_activate.role: primary source for vocabulary history and generic action scope
wizards_activate.paraphrase: The Sixth Edition rules standardized the term Activate for the pre-existing concept of activated abilities. The same article describes Attach as shared vocabulary used by Equipment and Auras.

wizards_attach_2017.role: explicit historical color placement for narrower named effect
wizards_attach_2017.paraphrase: The article puts moving enchantments/counters in blue. Its Equipment comment is a statement from 2017, not a claim verified for the current card pool.

wizards_archenemy.role: primary source for abandoning ongoing schemes
wizards_archenemy.paraphrase: An ongoing scheme remains active until abandoned, then goes on the bottom of the scheme deck.

scryfall_abandon.role: fresh query comparison; raw responses and SHA-256 receipts saved

records.label: Scryfall-derived assessment - provisional; playtest-only
records.rationale: The supplied Sojourner's Enforcermite text matches the saved Scryfall record: generic {6}, colorless artifact creature, Affinity for Affinity and Affinitycycling {2}. Its 6/6 statistics and Frog Myr Salamander type line are retained in the raw record. The one observed Affinitycycling design supplies a colorless home, not W/U/B/R/G tiers. Colorless Primary is a sparse-sample convention, not a published color-pie rule.

records.label: Verified rules scope; P/S/T not applicable
records.rationale: This is the action used by ongoing schemes. Colorless schemes are evidence of a special game-object operation, not a reason to rank it like a colored spell effect. The default fulloracle search returned Kobayashi Maru Scenario (Abandon Ship mode label) and Reckless Abandon (self-name), neither a use of the scheme action. Adding include:extras returns the 20 schemes plus those two false positives; filtering t:scheme yields the 20 relevant designs.
records.correction_to_prior_report: The earlier Abandon page incorrectly called Kobayashi Maru Scenario a future scheme preview. It is a blue Enchantment with an Abandon Ship mode label and was correctly excluded by the original ledger; this addendum corrects the prose.

records.classification: Universal rules action / not a color-pie effect
records.label: Official history and rules vocabulary; P/S/T not applicable
records.rationale: Activate describes using an activated ability, not the effect that ability produces. It is not an ability newly created in Sixth Edition; the standardized vocabulary was introduced then. A tap ability producing mana and an activated damage ability share this rules action but require separate effect-level analysis. Do not interpret rules-neutral as five Primary placements or as Colorless Primary.

records.label: Owner-directed classification; Scryfall-derived rationale
records.confidence: strong colorless home; exact category is a project classification
records.rationale: Adopt the user's stated Primary Colorless, Secondary None, Tertiary None. The prior screened population is dominated by colorless native uses and grants. A five-color playtest grant does not establish independent colored tiers. Colorless is a separate classification, not a sixth Magic color and not a synonym for the {C} mana symbol.

records.classification: Generic rules action, with linked effect-specific color-pie evidence
records.label: Generic action unranked; narrower effect explicitly sourced
records.rationale: Preserve the distinction between the generic Attach action and moving already attached enchantments. The 2017 article provides explicit Blue Primary evidence for its named Moving enchantments/counters category. Record that evidence alongside Attach rather than expanding the claim to every Equip or Aura-attachment action. Counter movement is also not itself the rules action of attaching a permanent.
